project_lead: Explicit name of the Leader of the project
primary_signer_name: Name of the first person who signed
document_stamp_id: Single (mostly vertical) stamped numeric identifier on the bottom section of the document
document_reference_number: Reference number of the document like form no., sheet no., notebook page, change no., code assigned, etc.
document_title: Title of the document usually mentioned at the top
document_date: Main top level date found in the document
date_received: Date when the item was received
date_issued: Date when the item was issued
date_reported: Date when the item was reported
project_name: Name of the project mentioned in the document
project_no_or_code: Project number or code found in the document
final_amount: The final cost, expenditure, or dollar sales amount (e.g., Total Cost, Adjusted Total Cost).
final_volume_or_quantity: Circulation numbers, sample sizes, or unit sales figures (e.g., Sample Size, Circulation (#)).
source_organisation: Name of the primary organisation/vendor/supplier mentioned in the document
compound_name: Name of the primary chemical compound
cc_list: Comma seperated stringified list of cc entities
